context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren forecast next year's numbers.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business planning; vocabulary (最大/国内/予想/収入/上昇) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来年の予想を、立ててくれたかね?
lines.en: Have you drawn up next year's forecast?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国内の売上は上昇の予想です。
lines.en: Yes, domestic sales are forecast to rise.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 最大で、どのくらい伸びるかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最大で、一割の上昇を予想します。
lines.en: At most, I forecast a ten-percent rise.
lines.style: precise young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の収入にも、回せるかね?
lines.en: Can we pass it to employee incomes too?
lines.style: caring boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 収入の上昇も、計画に入れます。
lines.en: I'll include an income rise in the plan.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国内の動きを、よく見てくれ。
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最大限、正確な予想を出します。
lines.en: I'll produce the most accurate forecast possible.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
